name: 52732 · Clinton, IA
findings: ZIP 52732 (Clinton) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52732 (Clinton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52732 (Clinton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
